title: Module 1: Privacy Threats from AI Systems
description: Identify four distinct privacy threats (re-identification, inference attacks, training-data leakage, surveillance-by-aggregation) and match each to its appropriate countermeasure (k-anonymity, differential privacy, federated learning, data minimization).

learning_objectives.statement: Distinguish re-identification, membership inference, attribute inference, and model inversion attacks
Recognize when removing direct identifiers is insufficient for anonymization
Match each privacy threat to an appropriate technical or governance countermeasure
Apply GDPR principles (data minimization, purpose limitation, retention limits) to AI deployment design

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
